blog_summary: This blog post marks the end of term for 'The Morning Paper' with Adrian Colyer taking a summer break. Instead of a regular paper analysis, the post highlights a curated list of noteworthy papers covered during the term. The selected papers span diverse areas including hardware/software co-design (Darwin), networking (NetChain), load balancing (Beamer), query languages (GraphQL), machine learning (CNNs, DNNs), privacy-preserving ledgers (zkLedger), code search (Deep code search), and secure databases (EnclaveDB). Adrian emphasizes the breadth of research shared and expresses gratitude to readers for their support. The post serves as a retrospective of impactful papers in systems, machine learning, and security.
